## Story DD Coverage
DD2: plugins/dso/scripts/check-corpus-schema.py and check-corpus-schema.sh exist and pass.
DD3 (partial): check-corpus-schema.sh is the pre-commit entrypoint (hook is registered in subsequent task).

## Context
Implement the corpus schema validator to make task a2b3-82d6's RED tests pass. The .py file validates YAML frontmatter against the schema vocabulary. The .sh file is the pre-commit entrypoint that wraps the .py via pre-commit-wrapper.sh. Both files must be executable.

## Implementation
- plugins/dso/scripts/check-corpus-schema.py: reads each staged .yaml file, parses frontmatter, validates tag values against the schema vocabulary in plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/_schema.yaml (or against hardcoded baseline if schema not yet present). Exits non-zero on any violation.
- plugins/dso/scripts/check-corpus-schema.sh: thin pre-commit entrypoint: exec-delegates to the Python script via pre-commit-wrapper.sh pattern.

## .test-index Entries Required
tests/scripts/test_check_corpus_schema.py -> plugins/dso/scripts/check-corpus-schema.py

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] plugins/dso/scripts/check-corpus-schema.py exists and is executable (chmod +x)
- [ ] plugins/dso/scripts/check-corpus-schema.sh exists and is executable (chmod +x)
- [ ] All RED tests in task a2b3-82d6 (test_check_corpus_schema.py) now PASS
- [ ] .test-index entry registered
- [ ] Follows pre-commit-wrapper.sh entrypoint pattern used by other hooks in plugins/dso/scripts/

## Given/When/Then
GIVEN a corpus .yaml entry with valid frontmatter
WHEN check-corpus-schema.sh runs on it
THEN exit 0 and no output
GIVEN a corpus .yaml entry with an invalid tag value
WHEN check-corpus-schema.sh runs on it
THEN exit non-zero with a descriptive error message
